quandoUsar: A floating bulk-action bar over a selection (files, photos, rows), with the three or four main actions always at hand and the rest a tap away.
Mobile screens or narrow panels, where the compact pill fits over the content and opens into a labeled grid only when requested.
quandoEvitar: Use `overflow-actions` for a fixed bar that moves to a “more” menu only the actions that do not fit the width.
Use `bloom-menu` to create new items from a floating button, without a selection.
Use `dropdown-menu` when the action list is long or has submenus.

teclado.acao: Move focus between all the bar's buttons, including the expand button and those of the secondary row, wrapping around.
Focus the first or last button of the bar.
With the bar expanded, collapses it and returns focus to the expand button.
Trigger the focused action, or expand and collapse the bar on the arrow button.

acessibilidade: The bar is a horizontal `role="toolbar"` with the fixed name “Actions”, and the expand button has `aria-expanded` and the name “Show all actions” or “Show fewer actions”.
In the compact form, each button gets `aria-label` and `title` with the action's `label`; when expanded, the visible text becomes the name. The secondary row is a `group` named by `shortcutsLabel`.
All buttons are in the Tab order (there is no roving focus); the arrow keys are an extra shortcut for moving through them.
movimento: The bar is a window that changes width and height on a spring with a slight bounce, growing upward from the pill, while the icons that were already there slide to their new place.
The extra icons appear in a cascade, the labels rise right after, and the arrow rotates 180°; when `label` changes, the new text enters from below and the old one exits above.
With “reduce motion” on, the bar takes the new size instantly and icons and labels just appear, with no slide or cascade.
responsivo: The expanded width is `width` (416px by default), limited to the container's space; the secondary row scrolls horizontally, with a faded end edge indicating there is more.
desempenho: A `ResizeObserver` follows the container and the content, and only a new target size triggers the spring, so resizing the window does not restart the animation on every frame.
notasIA: Import `ExpandableActionBar` by name (the default export is the preview with the file board) and mark the compact pill's three or four actions with `primary: true`.
The component takes the parent's width and anchors to its bottom edge: position the parent (for example, `position: absolute` at the footer) and show the bar only when there is a selection.
Handle clicks in `onAction(id)` and `onShortcut(id)`; `label` (such as “3 selected”) is the text that swaps with animation, and `shortcuts={[]}` removes the secondary row.
